name: danzly-browser-extension
description: Browser extension for submitting dance events to Danzly
author: Aleks-Daniel Jakimenko-Aleksejev <alex.jakimenko@gmail.com>

scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit && pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: vite build && node scripts/finalize-manifest.mjs dist && node scripts/package-extension.mjs dist chrome
scripts.build:firefox: TARGET_BROWSER=firefox vite build --outDir dist-firefox && node scripts/finalize-manifest.mjs dist-firefox && node scripts/package-extension.mjs dist-firefox firefox
